newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end up for 4th day on foreign bids.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end up for 4th day on foreign bids.

text.p: Caracas stocks rose the fourth consecutive session on continuing interest by foreign bidders, traders said, with blue chips taking most of the glory.
"Once more, it's foreigners bringing life to the market," said Bancaracas trader Ricardo Larrazabal.

The bolsa's 19-share .IBC index gained 0.84 percent to end at 6,683.38 points, while Merinvest's composite .MRCP index, which includes telephone company CANTV, rose 0.8 percent to close at 106.69 points.
Steel company Sivensa lead gainers, rising 4.38 percent to end at 161.00 bolivars, as a total 26 million shares exchanged hands, worth four billion bolivars ($8.5 million).
Among traded issues, 20 rose, 13 fell and five closed flat.
